data.name: Cauldron Cook
data.description: A gingerbread witch gains the cauldron and child-scent hexes. When brewing potions with her cauldron, she can create small candies, pastries, or similar edible items identical in effect and application to normal potions.

raw_tokens.value: A gingerbread witch gains the cauldron and child-scent hexes. When brewing potions with her cauldron, she can create small candies, pastries, or similar edible items identical in effect and application to normal potions.
She also gains the cook people hex.
